The URL allowlist:
  - ‎https://safe.example.com‏/admin/exfil
  - ‎https://trusted.local‏

The LRM (U+200E) and RLM (U+200F) characters above act as
directional marks that visually rearrange portions of the URL,
making what is logically /admin/exfil appear at a different point
in the visible string.
